title: Job title: Talent Acquisition Specialist – Global Capability Center (GCC)
description:
**Roll: Talent Acquisition Specialist – Global Capability Center (GCC)**

**Experience: 6+ Years**  
**Location: Hyderabad**  
**Industry: Global Capability Center (GCC) / IT / Technology**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist with 6+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, preferably within a **Global Capability Center (GCC), MNC, IT services or corporate environment**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, sourcing high-quality talent, partnering with hiring managers and business leaders, and supporting strategic hiring initiatives for the GCC.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Manage end-to-end recruitment** from requirement gathering to candidate onboarding.
* Partner with hiring managers, business leaders and HRBPs to understand hiring requirements and develop recruitment strategies.
* Handle multiple **technical and non-technical positions** across different business functions.
* Source candidates through **LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, employee referrals, job portals, Boolean search and professional networks.**
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for niche, critical and hard-to-fill positions.
* Conduct **candidate screening, interview coordination, feedback management and offer negotiations.**
* Manage **candidate engagement** throughout the recruitment lifecycle and improve **offer-to-join ratios.**
* Conduct talent mapping, market research and competitor analysis to identify potential talent pools.
* Work with **global stakeholders across different geographies and time zones**.
* Support **GCC expansion, ramp-up hiring and high-volume recruitment initiatives.**
* Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data in the **ATS**.
* Track recruitment metrics including **Time-to-Fill, Time-to-Hire, Offer Acceptance Rate, Offer-to-Join Ratio, Source of Hire and Hiring SLA.**
* Prepare recruitment reports and dashboards for management.
* Identify opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, recruitment processes and candidate experience.
* Ensure adherence to **company recruitment policies, processes and compliance requirements.**

**Required Skills**

* **6+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**.
* Experience in **GCC / Global Capability Center / MNC / IT Services recruitment** preferred.
* Strong experience in **technical and non-technical hiring**.
* Hands-on experience with **Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms.**
* Strong knowledge of **Boolean Search, X-Ray Search, Talent Mapping and Passive Candidate Sourcing.**
* Experience handling niche and hard-to-fill positions.
* Strong **stakeholder management and communication skills.**
* Experience working with **ATS / Recruitment CRM systems.**
* Good knowledge of **recruitment metrics and reporting.**
* Strong **negotiation and candidate engagement skills.**
* Ability to **manage multiple requisitions** and work in a **fast-paced environment.**

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting **GCC setup, expansion or ramp-up hiring.**
* Experience hiring for technology roles such as **Software Development, Cloud, DevOps, Data Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity and QA.**
* Exposure to hiring across **US, UK, Europe, APAC or other global markets.**
* Experience with **recruitment dashboards and analytics.**

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Location:** Hybrid

Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Pega System Architect (SA) to design, develop, and implement enterprise-grade BPM and case management solutions using the Pega Platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Pega application architecture, best practices, integration strategies, and performance optimization, and will play a key role in leading technical design and mentoring team members.

Solution Design Architecture

* Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Define application layer structure, class hierarchy, case types, data models, and integration patterns.
* Ensure adherence to Pega Guardrails and best practices.
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure quality and performance.

Development Implementation
  

* Develop complex case workflows, UI rules, data pages, decision rules, and integrations.
* Implement REST/SOAP integrations, connectors, and services.
* Configure and optimize decisioning, routing, SLAs, and business rules.
* Implement security, access control, and authentication mechanisms.
* Support DevOps practices including CI/CD and deployment automation.

Performance Optimization
  

* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Optimize database queries, reports, and background processing.
* Ensure application scalability and high availability.

Collaboration Leadership
  

* Provide technical leadership to Pega developers and System Architects.
* Mentor junior team members and review deliverables.
* Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and backlog refinement.
* Work closely with Business Architects and stakeholders for requirement clarification.
* Support UAT and production deployment activities.

Governance Compliance
  

* Ensure compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation for architecture, integrations, and deployment processes.
* Conduct guardrail compliance reviews and quality assurance checks.

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 1-3 + years of IT experience with Pega application development
* Strong experience with:
* Pega PRPC / Pega Platform (v7.x / v8.x or above)
* Case Management and BPM concepts
* Data modelling and class structure design
* Integration services (REST, SOAP, JMS, Kafka, etc.)
* Pega Decisioning and business rules
* UI/UX configuration using Pega UI frameworks
* Strong understanding of Pega guardrails and performance tuning.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Pega System Architect (CSA/SA) certification – Mandatory
* Experience with:
* Cloud deployments (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, etc.)
* Database systems (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
* Microservices architecture
* Experience in large-scale enterprise implementations.

Technical Skills
  

* Case lifecycle design
* Data pages and data transforms
* Activities and utility functions
* Decision tables, decision trees, and declarative rules
* Report definitions and performance optimization
* Authentication (OAuth, SSO, LDAP)
* Background processing and queue processors
* Pega Deployment Manager

Soft Skills
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to lead technical discussions and design workshops
* Strong documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
* Mentorship and team leadership capabilities

Key Competencies
  

* Solution Architecture
* Enterprise Integration
* Performance Engineering
* Technical Leadership
* Agile Delivery
* Risk Mitigation

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.

**TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER**

**We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**

**Position Snapshot:**

  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**

As a Test Automation Specialist, you will be working on the Business Applications powering the Nespresso Retail and Trade network, as well as Customer Relations Centers. You will work in an employee-facing applications context, supporting large volumes of internal users and transactions, while being part of a large development organization with a direct impact on the business.

As a central part of the software engineering community, you will bring deep technical expertise and knowledge to the product team, being part of the technical reference team for Nespresso web applications and focusing on quality strategy and automation practices. You will guide and promote the optimal use of processes and technology to support the cost-effective delivery of business requirements within your area of expertise.

As the Automation Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the correct execution of the QA and testing strategy across the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains, ensuring the quality and reliability of our business applications, with a strong focus on driving the test automation framework. You will work closely with cross-functional delivery teams to ensure the adoption of QA and testing practices, and with Release and DevOps teams to streamline the release cycle and improve the overall quality of our web applications. You will also make a strong contribution to the QA strategy through a community of practice in collaboration with the QA Office.

**In This Role, You Will:**

  

* Apply the test automation framework and infrastructure, ensuring its reliability and scalability.
* Contribute to the creation of a growing full test automation library.
* Participate in defining and keeping the QA and testing strategy for our Business Applications up to date.
* Participate in defining and keeping the test automation strategy and practices for Nespresso up to date, using industry-standard tools and frameworks to ensure maximum test coverage and efficiency.
* Ensure that cross-functional delivery teams in the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains follow the defined guidelines and deliver according to the quality standards of Nespresso release cycles.
* Mentor and guide QA engineers and testers, providing technical expertise and support in test automation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, DevOps, and Release Engineers to continuously improve the overall quality and efficiency of the testing process. Actively participate in the QA community of practice alongside QA Leads and the Nespresso QA Office.

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of professional experience.
* Proven experience as an Automation Test Engineer or in a similar role, specifically in web application testing.
* Strong knowledge of API testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks.
* Proven experience using Gherkin and Xray.
* Proficiency in using test automation tools and frameworks, such as Playwright.
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English with people at different levels of the organization.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

  

* Passion for technology, test automation, and DevOps, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical populations in a large organization.
* Experience working in a global environment and collaborating with virtual teams.

**We Offer You:**

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* **Stakeholder Interview:** Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* **Leadership & HRBP Interaction:** Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.

In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.

Job Description – HR Recruiter

**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Location:** Remote – Anywhere in India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Department:** Human Resources

About the Role

We are looking for an HR Recruiter with 2–3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, particularly in hiring for Sales, Business Development and other business-related roles in the Indian market.

The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing and screening skills, be comfortable managing multiple requirements and have the ability to drive positions from sourcing to successful onboarding.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for Sales, Business Development, Lead Generation and other business roles.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals and other recruitment platforms.
* Screen candidates based on skills, experience, salary expectations, notice period and role requirements.
* Conduct initial HR screening and assess candidate suitability.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and collect timely feedback.
* Maintain candidate pipelines and recruitment trackers.
* Handle salary discussions, offer negotiations and offer rollouts.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure successful joining.
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand hiring requirements and priorities.
* Ensure timely closure of assigned positions.

Required Skills & Experience

* 2–3 years of experience in HR Recruitment / Talent Acquisition.
* Hands-on experience in Indian recruitment.
* Prior experience hiring for Sales, Business Development, Inside Sales and Lead Generation roles.
* Good working knowledge of Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed and other recruitment portals.
* Strong candidate screening, communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple open positions independently.
* Good understanding of Indian salary structures and notice periods.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Profile

* Experience in IT, SaaS, Digital Marketing, Consulting or service-based companies.
* Target-oriented with a strong focus on recruitment closures.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability.

What We Are Looking For

A proactive recruiter who can independently manage hiring requirements, build a strong candidate pipeline and ensure quality hiring within agreed timelines.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent years working at the boundary where EDA tools meet real customer problems, and you have learned that the difference between a tool that gets adopted and one that gets abandoned usually comes down to whether someone showed up, understood the actual workflow, and made it work in context. You do not just know layout techniques, you know which ones matter for a given design constraint and why a customer might be hitting a wall at 2 a.m. before tapeout.

You are comfortable walking into a customer site, opening up a layout that is failing timing or DRC, and working backward through the problem without needing perfect information upfront. Tcl and Python are not just skills on your resume, they are how you automate the repetitive parts so you can focus on the hard diagnostic work. You can explain a complex tradeoff to a design team in terms they understand, and you can bring that same clarity back to your engineering team when a feature request or bug report needs context.

Working across teams and time zones does not slow you down. You know how to coordinate, escalate when needed, and keep things moving without waiting for someone else to connect the dots.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Work directly with customers onsite and remotely to debug layout issues, tool behavior, and design flow problems in live production environments
* Build and deliver technical demonstrations, training sessions, and best practice guidance tailored to customer design requirements and constraints
* Write Tcl and Python scripts to automate workflows, reproduce issues, and extend tool functionality for customer-specific use cases
* Diagnose tool performance bottlenecks, incorrect results, or unexpected behavior and work with internal R&D teams to resolve or work around them
* Collaborate with product management, engineering, and field teams to translate customer feedback into actionable feature requests and product improvements
* Present technical content to customer engineering teams and leadership, translating tool capabilities into design outcomes they care about
* Support pre-sales technical evaluations and proof-of-concept engagements when deep layout or applications expertise is required

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Customers will adopt Synopsys layout and design tools more effectively because you helped them understand how to use them in their actual workflow, not just in a demo
* Design teams will hit fewer late-stage layout roadblocks because you identified the issue early, scripted a solution, or escalated it to the right internal team
* Product engineering will build better tools because you brought back specific, contextualized feedback from real customer environments
Your scripts and automation will* customers hours per design cycle, compounding across dozens of tapeouts
* Internal teams will close critical bugs faster because you provided reproducible cases with real customer data and clear technical context
* Synopsys will win competitive evaluations because you showed up, solved the hard problem, and proved the tool works where it counts
* The broader applications engineering team will benefit from the workflows, scripts, and best practices you document and share

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in semiconductor design
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in layout design, physical verification, or applications engineering supporting EDA layout tools
* Strong working knowledge of layout techniques including floorplanning, placement, routing, and physical verification flows
* Proficiency in Tcl and Python for scripting, automation, and tool customization
* Experience working directly with customers in a technical support, applications, or field engineering capacity
* Solid understanding of electrical circuit fundamentals and how layout decisions affect design performance and manufacturability
* Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites for onsite support, training, and issue resolution

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a messy problem description, and ask the two or three questions that get to the actual root cause
* You are comfortable presenting technical material to a room of engineers or managers without over-explaining or losing the thread of what they need to know

* You treat customer issues like they are your own design problem, not someone else's ticket to close

title: Talent Partner - US Hiring
description:
**Talent Partner**

Qrata | Remote – United States | Full-Time

*Experience: 2–4 Years | Shift: U.S. Business Hours 6pm-3am (EST / CST / PST)*

**About the Role**

At Qrata, we believe hiring should be built on clarity, context, and trusted partnerships—not just résumés. As a Talent Recruiter on our U.S. team, you will go beyond sourcing profiles to become a strategic advisor to both clients and candidates. You’ll capture deep role insights to craft the perfect Role DNA, refine AI-generated scorecards to align with client requirements, and guide candidates through every step of the hiring journey.

This is a fully remote position supporting U.S.-based clients. You will work standard U.S. business hours and collaborate closely with hiring managers, candidates, and internal teams across U.S. time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Role Discovery & Research**

* Partner with U.S. hiring managers to understand business goals, team dynamics, and role-specific success metrics.

* Deep-dive into client needs, industry context, and organizational challenges to define what great talent looks like for each role.

* Translate insights into tailored Role DNA profiles and refine AI-generated scorecards to reflect nuanced hiring requirements.

**Advisory Screening & Candidate Engagement**

* Conduct thoughtful phone and video pre-screens assessing skills, motivations, and cultural fit for U.S.-based roles.

* Score candidates accurately against Role DNA, providing clients with clear, data-backed hiring recommendations.

* Build strong rapport with candidates, guide them through the interview process, align expectations, and support smooth onboarding.

**Client Partnership**

* Act as a trusted recruiting advisor—simplify hiring decisions, eliminate decision fatigue, and deliver proactive updates.

* Leverage Qrata’s analytics platform to share weekly hiring summaries and market insights that keep clients confident and informed.

* Develop long-term client relationships that drive repeat engagement and referrals.

**Hiring Excellence & Execution**

* Manage full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, supporting offer negotiations, reference checks, and onboarding.

* Maintain accurate candidate pipelines and ATS records; meet weekly and monthly hiring SLAs.

* Stay current on U.S. labor market trends, compensation benchmarks, and recruiting best practices.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree a plus.

* 2–4 years of full-cycle recruiting or talent acquisition experience supporting U.S.-based clients or roles (agency, RPO, or in-house).

* Hands-on experience sourcing and engaging U.S.-based candidates in tech, SaaS, or professional services preferred.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable in strategic conversations with U.S. hiring managers and senior stakeholders.

* Strong sourcing skills—proficient with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and modern ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.).

* Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously in a remote environment.

* Solid business acumen to understand roles, compensation norms, and organizational priorities in the U.S. market.

* Self-starter who thrives with autonomy, takes ownership of outcomes, and communicates proactively.

**U.S. Staffing & Contract / Tax Knowledge**

A strong understanding of U.S. staffing models, worker classifications, and tax terms is essential for this role. Candidates must be familiar with the following:

**Worker Classification & Employment Types**

* W-2 (Full-Time Employee) – Understand W-2 employment where the employer withholds federal/state income tax, Social Security, and Medicare (FICA). Know the difference between direct-hire W-2 and W-2 through a staffing agency.

* 1099 / Independent Contractor – Ability to explain 1099 contractor arrangements, self-employment tax obligations, and IRS criteria that distinguish contractors from employees (behavioral control, financial control, type of relationship).

* Corp-to-Corp (C2C) – Understand C2C engagements where a vendor’s corporation invoices the client company directly. Know how to identify legitimate C2C setups vs. misclassification risks.

**Tax Terms & Work Authorization**

* Tax Terms – Comfortable discussing tax terms with candidates: W-2 with benefits, W-2 without benefits, 1099, C2C, and hybrid models. Able to explain all-inclusive vs. plus-expenses billing rates.

* Work Authorization – Familiar with U.S. work authorization statuses: U.S. Citizen, Green Card (GC/PR), H-1B, H-4 EAD, OPT/STEM OPT, TN, L-1, E-3, and CPT. Able to screen candidates accurately and communicate sponsorship availability.

* H-1B Sponsorship – Basic understanding of the H-1B cap, lottery process, transfer vs. new filing, and the difference between cap-exempt and cap-subject employers.

* Right-to-Work (RTW) Verification – Knowledge of I-9 compliance requirements and E-Verify processes.

**Contract & Engagement Models**

* Contract / Contract-to-Hire (C2H) – Understand the structure of contract engagements, conversion clauses, and temp-to-perm arrangements. Able to communicate contract durations, extensions, and conversion timelines to candidates.

* Bill Rate vs. Pay Rate – Ability to calculate and discuss bill rates, pay rates, mark-ups, and gross margins in a staffing context.

* SOW vs. Staff Augmentation – Differentiate between Statement of Work (SOW) engagements and traditional staff augmentation, and understand when each model applies.

* Benefits & Compliance – Awareness of ACA (Affordable Care Act) compliance thresholds, benefits eligibility for contract workers, and state-specific payroll regulations (e.g., California, New York).

**Work Setup**

* 100% Remote – Work from anywhere in the United States.

* U.S. Shift Hours – Availability required during standard U.S. business hours (Eastern, Central, or Pacific time zones).

* Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace required.

**Our Values**

At Qrata, our values are not just words on a wall—they shape how we show up for clients and candidates every day:

* Radical Transparency – Communicate openly and honestly with teammates, clients, and candidates.

* Growth Mindset – Experiment, adapt, and continuously sharpen your craft.

* Team Accountability – Solve problems proactively and rally around collective success.

* Selflessness – Put Qrata’s mission and client outcomes above individual wins.

* Grit – Show persistence, resilience, and genuine care in every search you run.

*Qrata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

Pay: ₹650,000.00 - ₹780,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
* Work from home

description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

As a Technical Consultant, ServiceNow, you will configure, develop, and implement ServiceNow solutions aligned with business requirements and platform best practices. This role is primarily hands-on and focused on delivery.

You will work closely with Senior Technical Consultants, Principal Consultants, project managers, and client stakeholders to build scalable, supportable, and high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in one primary ServiceNow product CSM with an exposure to other products such ITSM, ITAM, HRSD, ITOM, or similar modules along with solid platform development skills and a strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and delivery excellence.

### **Roles & Responsibilities**

* Develop, configure, customize, and enhance ServiceNow applications based on business requirements and platform best practices.

* Design and implement solutions in one primary ServiceNow product CSM with an exposure to other products such as ITSM, ITAM, HRSD, ITOM or related modules.

* Build and support workflows, flows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, portals, workspaces, and integrations as needed.

* Develop and optimize integrations using supported ServiceNow capabilities, APIs, and standard methods.

* Troubleshoot issues, analyze root causes, and implement sustainable fixes.

* Perform unit testing, support QA and UAT, and contribute to code reviews and overall quality.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, manage assigned priorities, and raise risks or blockers early.

* Maintain technical documentation and stay current with ServiceNow platform capabilities.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* 3 to 6 years of experience working on the ServiceNow platform in a developer or technical consultant role.

* Strong hands-on experience in one primary ServiceNow product CSM with an exposure to other products such as ITSM, ITAM, HRSD, ITOM or related modules. .

* Solid experience in ServiceNow scripting using JavaScript, Glide APIs, workflows, Flow Designer, and platform customization.

* Good experience with integrations, REST APIs, imports, and automation capabilities within ServiceNow.

* Experience building or supporting Service Portal, Workspace, UI Builder, or related user interface components is preferred.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in a dynamic project environment.

* Good understanding of software development lifecycle principles and structured delivery methods.

* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively as part of a project team.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, or CIS are an advantage, though demonstrated hands-on capability is valued most.

### **Preferred Attributes**

* Strong ownership of assigned work and accountability for delivery of quality.

* Ability to understand business needs and convert them into practical technical solutions.

* Strong attention to documentation, testing, and delivery discipline.

* Willingness to learn new ServiceNow modules and platform capabilities over time.

* Professional, collaborative, and delivery-focused approach.

### **Success Profile**

A successful Technical Consultant in this role will be a strong hands-on builder who can independently deliver assigned technical work, contribute to solution quality, collaborate effectively with the wider delivery team, and bring strong depth in at least one primary ServiceNow product area.

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**India Employment Benefits include:**

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work-life balance

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations

**Inclusive and people-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**About Us:**

At Envision Next, we are revolutionizing the real estate industry by offering innovative solutions to developers that streamline their entire real estate life cycle. Originating from RERA consulting, we have grown into a dynamic organization that collaborates with top experts in advisory, legal, financial services, and technology. Our mission is to advance the industry through forward-thinking strategies and cutting-edge technology, setting new benchmarks and shaping the future of real estate excellence.

Recognized as **a Great Place to Work** for the second consecutive year 2025 – 2026, we are dedicated to fostering a positive and dynamic work environment where our team thrives. Our commitment to innovation and client satisfaction drives us to continually push boundaries, enabling a more secure, sustainable, and prosperous future for real estate.

At Envision Next, we're not just building systems; we're building the future of real estate. We invite you to join us on this transformative journey. Let's shape a more secure, sustainable, and prosperous tomorrow together.

Our company website link: **www.envisionnext.in**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a driven HR Executive to own the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding a hiring need to the day a new joiner walks in. You will partner closely with hiring managers, build strong talent pipelines, and deliver a smooth, professional experience for every candidate. The role suits someone who enjoys a fast pace, takes ownership of closures, and treats every hire as a reflection of the company's brand.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Workforce Planning & Requisition

* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, role expectations, team structure and timelines.
* Draft, refine and maintain accurate job descriptions and role specifications.

2. Sourcing & Talent Pipeline

* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.), social media, employee referrals and campus drives.
* Build and maintain a talent pool for recurring and critical positions.
* Post and manage job advertisements across relevant channels.

3. Screening & Assessment

* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic or video interviews to assess fit, experience, notice period and salary expectations.
* Coordinate technical tests or assignments where applicable.
* Shortlist and share qualified profiles with hiring managers within agreed turnaround times.

4. Interview Coordination

* Schedule and coordinate interview rounds with panels and candidates.
* Brief interviewers and candidates ahead of each round.
* Collect structured feedback promptly and keep candidates informed of their status at each stage.

5. Offer Management & Negotiation

* Conduct salary discussions and negotiate compensation within approved budgets.
* Draft and issue offer letters and appointment letters using approved templates, accurately covering designation, CTC breakup, joining date, probation, notice period and other key terms.
* Prepare the salary annexure / CTC breakup in coordination with Payroll, ensuring compliance with the company's compensation structure.
* Obtain internal approvals before release, and maintain version control and records of all offers issued.
* Prepare related letters as needed, such as revised offers, offer extensions and offer withdrawals.
* Manage offer roll-out and acceptance, and handle counter-offers.

6. Pre-Joining & Onboarding

* Stay in regular contact with selected candidates during the notice period to minimize dropouts.
* Coordinate background and reference verification.

7. Hiring Data & Reporting

* Maintain the recruitment tracker with accurate, up-to-date candidate data.
* Publish weekly and monthly MIS on open positions, pipeline status, closures and dropouts.
* Ensure the hiring process follows company policy and maintain proper documentation.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**  
Bachelor's degree in any field. An MBA in Human Resources or equivalent qualification is preferred.

**Desired Work Experience:** 2+ Years

**Skills:**  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, a results-oriented approach, leadership abilities, negotiation skills, adaptability and industry awareness, and a solid background in recruitment strategy.

**Remuneration:** As per industry standards and based on skills and experience.

**Company Culture:** We are committed to maintaining a strong ethical foundation built on professionalism, transparency, and mutual respect. By cultivating a culture of trust and collaboration, we strive to create a dynamic workplace where every individual is valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* Mention your current CTC.
* Mention your current location.
* Mention your notice period.
